$comment: Prisma blog/social cover design tokens — 2026 rebrand ('prism' brand). Values are sourced from the rebranded eclipse package (prisma/web: packages/eclipse/src/styles/globals.css) and the marketing site app's globals.css @theme block + product accent map (the app currently named apps/site-redesign; it replaces apps/site at cutover — check apps/site if that name is gone). Treat this file as the single source of truth for generated covers; update it when the brand tokens change. The pre-rebrand dark 'aurora' palette is retired — do not reach for it.

background.$comment: Signature surface — LIGHT paper. A white (#ffffff) or paper (#f9faf5) canvas with (1) a subtle grain texture (SVG feTurbulence, multiply, ~0.05 opacity) and (2) an optional 'spectral wash': two-to-three soft radial gradients of the prism colors (cyan/yellow/red at 14-26% via color-mix) pooling along one edge or corner and dissolving to white. This luminous paper-plus-prism-wash is the brand signature. Dark covers are the exception (see inverse).

wash.type: 2-3 radial gradients along one edge, dissolving to the surface color
wash.note: positions vary per cover; a bottom-edge pool (like the site heroes) is the house default

grain.how: feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency 0.9, opacity ~0.05, blend multiply

inverse.$comment: Dark variant for the rare cover that needs it: brand ink surface, paper text, same prism accents.

accents.$comment: The three prism colors. Use ONE as the cover's accent (dot, highlight, hero element), chosen by product (see products) or topic; the other two may appear only inside the spectral wash or a deliberate three-stripe prism motif. Never introduce other hues.

card.$comment: Cards sit ON the light surface: white fill, hairline ink border, soft shadow, generous radius. Inner wash surface for chips/rows uses the card-wash tint. Keep cards ≥48px off the canvas edge.

codeInk.$comment: Code/terminal cards may invert to ink for contrast on the light canvas — the ONE sanctioned dark element per cover.

kicker.$comment: The brand eyebrow = a small colored DOT + a sentence-case semibold label. NOT uppercase, NOT letter-spaced, NO dash — those are the retired style. Dot color = the cover's accent.

prismMotif.$comment: Optional brand device: 45° diagonal bands in cyan/red/yellow (the logo's anatomy), used as a corner glyph, an edge bleed, or a divider. One motif max; keep it geometric and crisp, never a blurred rainbow.

fonts.$comment: The 2026 brand pairing: Sora (display, weight 500-600 — NOT 800), Inter (body 400, labels 600), Mona Sans Mono (code/data 500). All bundled as variable fonts in assets/fonts/. Mona Sans display and Geist Mono are RETIRED for covers; Barlow was never on-brand.

display.role: Titles, headlines, big numbers, the Prisma wordmark sign-off
display.note: Sora VF (bundled). Headlines are weight 500, sentence case, tight leading (~1.06-1.1). Weight 600 only for small emphasis (wordmark, stat callouts). Never 700+.

body.role: Subtitles, descriptions, kicker labels (600), UI text

mono.role: Code snippets, data values, file paths, terminal text

typeScale.$comment: px values for the canonical 1200x630 canvas; scale proportionally for other formats.

wordmark.$comment: Brand sign-off. PREFERRED: the small full-color lockup (assets/logos/prisma-lockup-color.svg) inlined at ~112px wide — the mark carries at grid-thumbnail scale where small grey type disappears. Fallback: the word 'Prisma' in Sora 600 ink ~24px. In whichever bottom corner is clear of content, inside the 72px crop-safe margin (lockup right edge ≤1128 on a 1200 canvas). Never the URL prisma.io/blog; never an icon paired with extra 'Prisma' text.
wordmark.position: a bottom corner clear of content, ≥72px from edges

safeZone.$comment: Blog cards crop covers to ~16:9 via object-cover and render them ~400px wide beside the post title, on light AND dark surfaces. Critical elements stay ≥72px from every edge and survive a centered 16:9 crop; kicker ≥20px or omitted; headline ≤6 words, never the post title restated; cover washes run stronger than page washes (~0.18–0.28 per stop) so the piece holds on dark.

products.$comment: Per-product accent from the redesigned site (PLATFORM_PRODUCT_ACCENTS). One accent per cover. The old teal-Postgres / indigo-ORM mapping is retired.

postgres.label: Prisma Postgres
postgres.note: the kicker dot may use #f3c306 (yellow-300) for pop on white, as the site does

prisma8.label: Prisma 8
prisma8.note: Prisma 8 (the ORM's next major, release candidate) rides the ORM cyan

platform.label: Prisma
platform.note: topic posts with no single product owner default to cyan, or pick the accent that matches the post's subject

formats.$comment: Dimensions verified against prisma/web. 'hero' is the in-post image (heroImagePath). 'social' is the OG/preview image (metaImagePath). Filenames follow the blog repo convention: hero.(svg|jpg) and meta.png under <slug>/imgs/.
